request.approved_script: Harry Kane’s breakthrough began with four loans: Leyton Orient, Millwall, Norwich City and Leicester City. In April 2014, he made his first Premier League start for Tottenham, and scored against Sunderland. Then came 2014–15. Thirty-one goals in all competitions. Twenty-one in the Premier League. The loan years were the route. That season was the breakthrough.
